mapper.update: UPDATE physical_marketing_quota SET state = IF(surplus_qty >= 0 AND surplus_qty = #{quantity} AND state = 'open', 'exhausted', state), waiting_qty = waiting_qty + #{quantity}, surplus_qty = IF(surplus_qty < 0, surplus_qty, surplus_qty - #{quantity}), update_time = NOW() WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND (surplus_qty < 0 OR surplus_qty >= #{quantity})
UPDATE physical_marketing_quota SET waiting_qty = waiting_qty - #{quantity}, issued_qty = issued_qty + #{quantity}, update_time = NOW() WHERE inv_id = #{invId} AND waiting_qty >= #{quantity}
mapper.select: SELECT id, inv_id, name, decr, surplus_qty, waiting_qty, issued_qty, state, create_time, update_time FROM physical_marketing_quota WHERE state = 'open'
SELECT inv_id AS invId, surplus_qty AS surplusQty, waiting_qty AS waitingQty, issued_qty AS issuedQty FROM physical_marketing_quota WHERE inv_id IN #{invId}
